title: Glossary
slide_intent: Give collaborators a shared meaning for production and identity terms so a brief or proof can be interpreted consistently.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can align a local program’s language with that of printers and designers by putting brand concepts and fabrication terms in one reference.
demonstration: Three columns of alphabetized definitions run from Artwork through Uncoated paper. Bold terms distinguish entries within the paragraphs.
practical_value: Use the glossary to distinguish a primary from a secondary color palette or to resolve terms such as bleed, CMYK and reverse before approving a file.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Place the gray Management label in the left margin and the red Glossary title at the main column edge.

content_islands.name: Definitions
content_islands.spec: Arrange compact definitions in three columns with bold lead terms. Preserve alphabetical order across the columns and leave a gap between entries.
